about: Prompt blocks for story-ranking-short. scripts/ranking.mjs assembles every still and clip prompt from these rows and the approved script; send the assembled prompt unchanged. Rows with `from` restate a vendor line (Everygen ranking-videos, no licence stated) in SL8 wording and pass `workflow-check.mjs copy`. Rows with `source` and `copied: true` keep fal agent-skill wording under its attribution. Every other row is SL8-authored for this skill, because the vendor's companion prompt files were never served (research everygen/rankingvideos-1aa4ce#3). None of this wording has been run on fal-ai/nano-banana-pro or bytedance/seedance-2.0 yet.

rows.use: every still and every edit, first
rows.prompt: Vertical 9:16 photo that looks like a frame grabbed from an ordinary smartphone video: handheld at chest height, natural available light, real everyday location, true-to-life colour, slight phone-sensor grain.

Real skin with pores and small blemishes, real fabric creases, everyday clutter in the background, imperfect framing, ordinary people with ordinary faces; nothing glossy, airbrushed or staged like an advert.
The picture runs to every edge of the frame, with sharp content right up to the sides and corners.
The scene carries no lettering of any kind: walls, screens, clothing and packaging are plain or turned away, and the frame shows no date or time stamp.
The only writing anywhere in the frame is the title and the numbered list given in this prompt; every other surface is plain or turned away, and there is no date or time stamp.

Keep the upper half of the frame calm (sky, wall, ceiling or soft background) so text can sit there later; the subject and the action sit in the middle band of the frame, between about 45% and 75% of its height.
Text sizes: the title is large, heavy and centred across the top; the numbered list is small, caption-sized, in the left half of the frame; no text covers the subject.

Text position: the title starts a little below the top edge (below the top 8% of the frame) and the list begins directly under it, hugging the left edge; the whole text block stays in the upper part of the frame, above the middle, and clear of the right-hand 12%.

Edit @Image1. Replace the scene with the new scene below. Keep the title and every list line already written exactly as they are: same words, font, size, colour, outline and place. Write exactly one new list line, in the slot named below, in the same style as the other lines. Every other slot keeps only its number.

rows.use: painted route ladder edits on openai/gpt-image-2/edit (no @ tags; the references are named by order)
rows.prompt: Edit the first image. Replace the scene with the new scene below. Keep the title and every list line already written exactly as they are: same words, font, size, colour, outline and place. Write exactly one new list line, in the slot named below, in the same style as the other lines. Every other slot keeps only its number.

rows.use: painted route edit after a title-style change
rows.prompt: @Image2 is the approved first still: match its title and list style exactly (font, size, box or outline, colour, position).
Real-time playback at true 1x pace, every movement at natural speed.
The action begins within the opening second and its result is plainly visible before the three-second mark.
Write the result as something the camera sees happen, for example: the mug tips off the counter and breaks apart on the floor.
The phone camera holds nearly still through the impact, with smooth steady framing.
Continue from the uploaded first frame, single continuous shot, same lighting direction throughout.
Bodies and objects keep their shape, weight and count from start to end; things fall, bounce and settle the way they would in real life.

rows.use: every clip unless the boom was dropped
rows.prompt: The deep bass hit lands on the exact frame of the impact.
A heavy bass drop sounds on the very first frame.
The painted title and list stay sharp, fixed in place and unchanged for the whole clip.
Every surface in the scene stays plain and free of writing for the whole clip.

rows.use: every clip, last; ranking.mjs adds what stays fixed
rows.prompt: What should not change:
Ranking <adjective> <topic> <emoji>
or reply 'your call' and I will choose.

rows.use: the line after the first still is approved
rows.prompt: First still fixed as the master: attempt <n>.
